- 1:00–2:00 PM (best for live demo + short admin)
- 2:30–3:30 PM (if you need a slightly later arrival window)

If neither of those fits, we can:

- Assign Marissa (onsite field engineer) to run a shortened session if my schedule conflicts — she knows your account and can present the integration story well.

Attached is a quick itinerary draft (Novus-demo-itinerary-v2.xlsx). Can you confirm which option you prefer and whether Kevin will be joining? Also please share any visitor/security instructions for your building.
